name: Nyírmada (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Nyírmada: a crowned blue shield with a white bird and flowers, with red, blue and yellow mantling and flags, above a scroll inscribed NYÍRMADA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nyírmada arms with crown, mantling and scroll
